steps.caption: Clients
steps.narration: On Clients in the ConstructHUB CRM, these tabs sort your clients by where their bid stands.

steps.caption: All, Job Won, Undecided, Declined
steps.narration: Each tab has a count: All, Job Won, Undecided and Declined.

steps.caption: Job Won
steps.narration: Choose Job Won to see the clients who approved an estimate.

steps.caption: The Bid column
steps.narration: The Bid column shows the same status on each row.

steps.caption: Undecided
steps.narration: Undecided is everyone with an estimate you've sent that they haven't answered.

steps.caption: Who to follow up
steps.narration: These clients are still deciding, so this is a good list to call.

steps.caption: Declined
steps.narration: Declined lists clients who turned an estimate down.

steps.caption: Nobody yet
steps.narration: Nobody has declined here, so this list is empty.

steps.caption: A dash
steps.narration: A dash means the client has no sent, approved or declined estimate.

steps.caption: Kept up to date
steps.narration: You never set the status yourself. It comes from the client's estimates.

steps.caption: Menu: Clients
steps.narration: You'll find the tabs on Clients, in the menu on the left.

youtube.title: How to sort clients by bid status | ConstructHUB CRM
youtube.description: A short walkthrough of the bid status tabs on Clients in the ConstructHUB CRM. You will see who has approved an estimate, who has not answered yet, and where each status comes from.
